```{r setup-mascot_bubble, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

### How long a bubble stays

```{r mascot_bubble-timeline, echo = FALSE}
guide_timeline("shown", "duration = 5: hides", "Inf: stays")
```

<div class="pg-callout pg-callout-warn">

<strong>HTML is trusted as it is.</strong>
Plain text is escaped and always safe. Wrap only your own content in HTML(), never untrusted visitor
input. Bootstrap classes such as badge, table, and progress work inside the bubble because bslib includes
Bootstrap.

</div>
